milestone.title: Settings lane UX polish — boolean dot, choice chip strip, legend consistency pass

intent.outcome: Config rows in the Settings lane render their value visually instead of as a string. Booleans become a single ●/○ dot in palette.success / palette.dim. Choices become a chip strip — one chip per allowed value, with the active chip in palette.accent. Each chip is mouse-clickable. The legend across all lanes is audited for consistency, and the per-tab footer table is updated where today's footers misrepresent the actual bindings. Bool and choice rows no longer open an editor on Enter because the live-toggle path is already complete.

problem.description: Two related UX gaps surfaced in the 2026-09-26 audit pass on the Settings lane: (a) every boolean config row currently renders as text '[bool] true' / '[bool] false' even though Space already toggles in place — a flag indicator would make the boolean-state visible without forcing the user to read a literal string; (b) every choice config row renders as text '[choice] mocha' even though the schema carries the full allowed-list and the renderer never reads it — a chip strip would make the choices discoverable, comparable to how the M243 theme picker lists all 7 themes on a screen. Side issue: the footer_per_tab table at crates/raul/src/tui/keybinds.rs:998 is mostly consistent across lanes but has known gaps — most visibly Milestones Detail lists Tab/Shift+Tab:section and ↑/↓:item glyphs that Backlog Detail does not, even though both detail views support the same review/approval actions. The fix is small (renderer change) but the discoverability gain is real for first-time users.

in_scope: Update crates/raul/src/tui/render/overlays.rs::render_settings_list so boolean rows render as a single colored dot (palette.success when on, palette.dim when off) replacing the text '[bool] true' / '[bool] false' span. Style sourced from new palette roles: focus_ring could be used for the off state per M244.

Update the same function for choice rows: read schema.allowed via the existing schema introspection path, render each allowed value as a single chip, the active chip in palette.accent + bold + reverse-video, the others in palette.foreground. Overflow becomes palette.dim ellipsis `…` after the row width is exceeded.

Wire mouse hit-test rects for every choice chip — clicking a chip sets the staged value to that name and updates the active-chip highlight. The bool flag also gets a hit-test rect (click toggles) for symmetry. Reuses the existing M221 mouse plumbing pattern.

Skip the editor-open path for bool and choice rows: when Enter is pressed on these rows, treat as no-op (Space / ← / → / click is the supported path). The per-type hint line in the description card updates accordingly: 'Space/click: toggle · s: save · Esc: back' for bool, '←/→/click: cycle · s: save · Esc: back' for choice.

Legend consistency pass: ensure Backlog · Detail footer_per_tab carries the same 'section' / 'item' navigation glyphs as Milestones · Detail if those keys are actually bound on Backlog Detail (action.rs around 1124 — verify and emit consistently); add a clarifying comment to Lane::Path → '' (empty) so the lack of a per-tab row doesn't look accidental in a future audit.

Add a test fixture that asserts every (lane, content_state) pair in Keybinds::footer_per_tab produces a non-empty string OR carries an explicit comment that the lane is read-only. Catches silent regressions when new lanes are added.
out_of_scope: Adding new schema attribute types beyond what schema.rs already accepts — only the consumer side changes.
Refactoring SettingsFocus::Editing or other internals — bool/choice just stop opening the editor.
Mouse hit-test refactor more broadly — only the bool dot and choice chips get hit-tests; the rest of the lane keeps existing behavior.
Changing how the `mp config` CLI reads/writes or how `mp config schema` formats its output. The schema field is already there.
Refactoring the per-lane keybinds themselves (footer_per_tab is purely a renderer of existing bindings).

acceptance_criteria.description: Boolean config rows in the Settings list render as a single ●/○ dot in palette.success / palette.dim. No text 'true' / 'false' is rendered for these rows. Mouse click and Space both toggle in place; the dot updates immediately (live-apply on highlight-style action).

Choice config rows in the Settings list render as a chip strip — one chip per schema.allowed value, with the active chip styled in palette.accent + bold + reverse-video and the inactive chips in palette.foreground. Mouse click on a chip selects that value.
Choice chip strips that exceed row width render up to the width-limit, then a palette.dim ellipsis (…) takes the remaining space. The full list remains visible in the description card and on hover.

Bool and choice rows do NOT open an editor on Enter. The corresponding SettingsFocus::Editing transition is bypassed; the description card hint line shows the new live-action verbs ('Space/click: toggle' / '←/→/click: cycle') instead of 'Enter: edit'.

Backlog · Detail and Milestones · Detail carry the same 'section' / 'item' / 'annotate' / 'menu' / 'approve' navigation glyphs when those keys are bound. Lane::Path's empty per-tab row carries a comment explaining it's intentional (read-only lane).
A test fixture iterates every (lane, content_state) pair in Keybinds::footer_per_tab and asserts the per-tab row is non-empty OR carries the documented 'read-only' comment.
make lint + make test + make consumer-surface-lint + cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings remain green.
acceptance_criteria.verification: make lint && make test && make consumer-surface-lint

work_packages.name: Boolean dot
work_packages.goal: Render bool rows as a single dot replacing the [bool] true string. Click hit-test toggles in place.
work_packages.rollback: Restore text rendering and drop the hit-test for the dot.

work_packages.name: Choice chip strip
work_packages.goal: Render choice rows as a chip strip from schema allowed. Click and arrow keys select. Ellipsis on overflow.
work_packages.rollback: Restore text rendering and drop chip click handler.

work_packages.name: Editor skip + hint
work_packages.goal: Bool and choice rows do NOT open an editor on Enter. Description card hint line updates to live-action verbs.

work_packages.name: Legend consistency + verify
work_packages.goal: Backlog Detail parity with Milestones Detail; Path empty per-tab is intentional; new fixture catches empty strings.
work_packages.rollback: Drop the parity fix; revert the new fixture.

steps.action: Render bool rows in render_settings_list as a single dot. On = ● in palette.success; off = ○ in palette.dim. Replace the existing text true / false span. Width budget 1 cell.
Add a mouse hit-test rect for the bool dot. Click toggles in place. Reuses the existing M221 mouse plumbing pattern. Space still toggles for keyboard users.
Wire mouse hit-test rects for every choice chip. Click selects the clicked chip's value. Arrow keys Left Right cycle; the existing SettingsCycleChoice action already handles it.
Add overflow handling. When chip strip exceeds row width render up to the limit then palette.dim ellipsis takes the remaining space. Description card and hover show the full list.
Wire mouse hit-test rects for every choice chip. Click selects the clicked chip. Arrow keys cycle via existing SettingsCycleChoice.
Add overflow handling for chip strip. When exceeds row width render up to the limit then palette.dim ellipsis takes the remaining space. Description card and hover show the full list.
Update the per_type_hint footer string to use live-action verbs: bool = Space/click: toggle s: save Esc: back; choice = / /click: cycle s: save Esc: back.
Bypass SettingsFocus::Editing on Enter for bool and choice rows. Treat Enter as no-op. Space and arrow keys remain the supported path.
Update the per_type_hint footer string to use live-action verbs: bool = Space/click: toggle s: save Esc: back; choice = / /click: cycle s: save Esc: back.
Add a comment on Lane::Path → footer_per_tab that empty string is intentional (read-only lane). Pin it so a future audit does not silently remove the conditional.

Add a test fixture iterating every (lane, content_state) pair in Keybinds::footer_per_tab asserting the per-tab row is non-empty OR carries the documented read-only comment. Catches silent regressions when new lanes are added.
Run make lint, make test, make consumer-surface-lint, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings. Verify all ACs.
